If statement An If statement implements branching logic based on a testable condition – example: The left pane of this table shows pseudo code – a combination of VB and English to help you organize program logic. The right pane shows a program flowchart – a logic diagram that can also help you organize program logic.
The True branch corresponds to the keyword Then and the False branch corresponds to the keyword Else in the pseudo code. The circle at the end represents the End If statement. You can code an unlimited number of statements inside either the True or False branches.
